title: coord.py wait --pid counts an exited but unreaped process as running, and has no guard against a reused pid
goal: coord.py wait --pid P reports P in ended when P has exited and not been reaped; a reused pid is not mistaken for the watched process

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp");st=os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite")
z=s.Popen(["true"]);time.sleep(1)  # exited, not waited for: a zombie
p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",st,"wait","--since","0","--timeout","4","--pid",str(z.pid)],capture_output=True,text=True)
z.wait();out=json.loads(p.stdout)
print(p.returncode,out["ended"],out["timed_out"])
sys.exit(0 if z.pid in out["ended"] else 1)
